sampling.nonzero_angle_signed_run_policy: run both plus and minus bearings
sampling.refinement_selection: main-grid 4-neighbor robust-state change edge, or any run with abs(rho_fuze - 1) <= 0.25

classification_policy.robust_hit: max rho_fuze across seeds and signed bearings <= 1
classification_policy.robust_miss: min rho_fuze across seeds and signed bearings > 1
classification_policy.N: robust_hit cell whose existing 8-neighbors are all robust_hit
classification_policy.O: robust_miss cell whose existing 8-neighbors are all robust_miss

policy.angle_axis: at fixed range, robust_miss followed by a larger-angle robust_hit is a reversal
policy.range_axis: at fixed angle, the robust-hit ranges may form at most one interval; near-O -> hit -> far-O is allowed
policy.mixed_cells: not treated as robust hit or robust miss

refinement_aware_sampled_audit.scope: all measured main and selected refinement cells

limitations: This is a deterministic engineering CV envelope, not real AIM-120 engagement authority.
The N/M/O labels are rebuilt from the selected simulation mechanisms and are not real-world Pk classes.
Refinement is data-selected after the coarse grid; unsampled fine cells remain unknown.
APN gain remains frozen at 0.5 although the target has zero truth acceleration.
